title: dfw configuration (global ~/.config/dfw/config.json, project .dfw/config.json, local .dfw/config.local.json)
description: Layers merge in order defaults < global < project < local. Objects merge; scalars and arrays replace, except gate.allow, gate.immutable and skills.disabled, which are unions across layers.

marketplaceRepo.description: Global only: path of the dfw-marketplace checkout

onEdit.description: PostToolUse checks: fast = dfw lint only (default), full = all tools, false = off

layoutOnStop.description: Rendered layout check of changed screens before Claude stops (default true)

env.description: Environment applied to external tools (telemetry and update checks off by default)
